headline: Appeals and variance requests for six properties, including 994 Green Hill Beach Road and 229 Saugatucket Road.
summary: Three appeals of zoning enforcement officer decisions are listed, two of them continued from earlier meetings. Four variance petitions seek relief from setback and floor area limits for homes and an accessory dwelling unit.
items: Continued appeal ZA-26-4 by Alexander Petrucci of a zoning enforcement officer decision for 84 Frank Avenue
Continued appeal ZA-26-5 by Rogers Home Inc. of a zoning enforcement officer decision for 28 Columbia Street
Dimensional variance petition ZBR-26-34 by Nancy Depathy to replace the home at 994 Green Hill Beach Road with a 3,160 sq. ft. dwelling, 910 sq. ft. over the 2,250 sq. ft. limit
Dimensional variance petition ZBR-26-35 by David Pearson to build a home 20 feet from the front line and 5 feet from the side line at 0 Silver Lake Avenue
Dimensional variance petition ZBR-26-37 by Melissa Towle for a one-story addition 30 feet from the rear line at 73 Narragansett Avenue West, 5 feet short of the 35-foot setback
Dimensional variance petition ZBR-26-38 by Kathleen Machala for an addition to an accessory dwelling unit at 229 Saugatucket Road, 2,256 sq. ft. against a 1,200 sq. ft. limit
Appeal ZA-26-6 by Kathleen Machala of a zoning enforcement officer decision dated October 9, 2026, for 229 Saugatucket Road
location: South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879
plain_text:
Posted on November 4, 2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Zoning Board of Review Meeting  
Meeting Agenda   
Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 7:00 PM   
South Kingstown Town Hall, Town Council Chambers 
180 High Street, Wakefield, RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Robert Cagnetta, Chair 
Thomas Daniels, Vice Chair 
Arlene Hicks, Member 
Geoff Elia, Member 
William MacDonald, Member 
Vacancy, Alt. #1 
Vacancy, Alt. #2 
Vacancy, Alt. #3 
  
A. Call to Order 
B. Chairman Introductions and Instructions 
C. Agenda Items *Order can be subject to change* 
 I. Continuation of Appeal ZA-26-4: Alexander Petrucci, 220 Knowlesway Extension, Narragansett, RI 
02882, requests an Appeal under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to Appeal 
the determination of the Zoning Enforcement Officer (ZEO), set forth in a letter dated August 11, 
2026. The owner is Sophia Industrial Park, LLC for premises located at 84 Frank Avenue, South 
Kingstown, Assessor's Map 22-1, Lot 88, and is zoned IND-1. 
84 Frank Avenue - Application 
 II. Continuation of Appeal ZA-26-5: Rogers Home Inc., 70 Foster Sheldon Road, Wakefield, RI 
02879, requests an Appeal under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: The applicant is seeking to 
Appeal the determination of the Zoning Enforcement Officer (ZEO), set forth in a letter dated 
August 27, 2026. The owner is Rogers Home Inc. for premises located at 28 Columbia Street, 
South Kingstown, Assessor's Map 57-1, Lot 43, and is zoned CN. 
28 Columbia Street - Application 
 III. Petition ZBR-26-34: Nancy Depathy requests a Dimensional Variance under the Zoning 
Ordinance as follows: The applicant seeks to demolish the existing dwelling and construct a new 
dwelling containing 3,160 sq. ft. in floor area.  The maximum floor area permitted is 2,250 sq. ft, 
therefore, relief of 910 sq. ft. is requested. Lot size is .17 acre. A Dimensional Variance is 
required per Zoning Ordinance Section 601 (Special Flood Hazard Overlay District) and 
Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owners are Mark & Nancy Depathy for premises located at 
994 Green Hill Beach Road, Assessor’s Map 96-1, Lot 77 and is zoned R30. 
994 Green Hill Beach Road - Application 
 IV. Petition ZBR-26-35: David Pearson requests a Dimensional Variance under the Zoning 
Ordinance as follows: The applicant seeks to construct a single-family dwelling 20’ from the front 
property line and 5’ from the side property line. The required front and side yard setbacks are 25’ 
and 10’, therefore, relief of 5’ is requested from both.  Lot size is .95 acre. A Dimensional 
Variance is required per Zoning Ordinance Section 401 (Schedule of Dimensional 
Regulations) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owner of the property is David Pearson for 
premises located at Assessor’s Map 63-2, Lot 77, and is zoned R10. 
0 Silver Lake Avenue - Application 
 V. Petition ZBR-26-37: Melissa Towle requests a Dimensional Variance under the Zoning Ordinance 
as follows: The applicant seeks to construct a one-story addition to the dwelling. The addition will 
be 30’ from the rear property line. The required rear yard setback is 35’, therefore, relief of 5’ is 
requested. Lot size is .47 acre. A Dimensional Variance is required per Zoning Ordinance 
Section 401 (Schedule of Dimensional Regulations) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). 
Owners of the property are Allen & Melissa Towle for premises located at 73 Narragansett Avenue 
West, Assessor’s Map 57-2, Lot 29, and is zoned R20. 
73 Narragansett Avenue West - Application
Posted on November 4, 2026 
 VI. Petition ZBR-26-38: Kathleen Machala requests a Dimensional Variance under the Zoning 
Ordinance as follows: The applicant seeks to construct an addition to an Accessory Dwelling Unit 
(ADU). The proposed floor area within the ADU will be 2,256 sq. ft. The maximum floor area 
permitted within an ADU is 1,200 sq. ft, therefore, relief of 1,056 sq. ft. is requested. Lot size is 
11.64 acres. A Dimensional Variance is required per Zoning Ordinance Section 401 
(Schedule of Dimensional Regulations) and Section 907 (Standards of Relief). Owner of the 
property is Kathleen Machala for premises located at 229 Saugatucket Road, Assessor’s Map 34-4, 
Lot 33 and is zoned R80. 
229 Saugatucket Road - Application 
 VII. Appeal ZA-26-6: Kathleen Machala requests an Appeal under the Zoning Ordinance as follows: 
The applicant seeks to Appeal the determination of the Zoning Enforcement Officer (ZEO), set 
forth in a letter dated October 9, 2026. The owner is Kathleen Machala for premises located at 229 
Saugatucket Road, Assessor’s Map 34-4, Lot 33, and is zoned R80. 
229 Saugatucket Road - Application 
D. Other Items 
 I. Attendance for the December 16, 2026, Zoning Board of Review meeting 
 II. Approval of the October 21, 2026, Zoning Board of Review Minutes 
 III. Adjournment
